hypothesis: A qwen36 CUDA chain prompt chunk of more than 32 rows copies each layer's host-pool experts into one staging buffer, so the copy of a layer waits for the experts of the layer before. With two banks that the staged layers take in turn, a layer's copy runs beside the layer before's experts and a prompt is faster, with the same logits.
